title: Pap and Wors
description: Pap and Wors is a South Africa classic prepared with cornmeal, bratwurst, yellow onion, tomato. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Grilled bratwurst stands in for South African boerewors, not available in the catalog.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 10 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Slowly stir the grains into the simmering liquid; cook over low heat for about 21 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.
Grill over medium-high heat for about 22 minutes, turning regularly until charred outside and safely cooked inside.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 12 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
